sources.title: Sakura confirms continued Ishikari operation in DCC participation announcement
sources.summary: Operator says it has operated the named Ishikari Data Center since 2011 and continues developing large GPU infrastructure there.
sources.date_semantics: July 28 is a dated present-tense operating-campus confirmation, not first opening, commissioning, or proof that a planned phase is complete.

sources.title: Sakura Ishikari container facility power maintenance completion
sources.summary: Named Ishikari container-type facility power maintenance was explicitly recorded complete at 12:35 on July 27, 2026; the notice addresses continuing customer rack power and cooling.
sources.date_semantics: Initial publication day not exposed. The explicit July 27, 2026 12:35 completion update corroborates existing live-campus operations; no status transfers to Building 3 C/D.

sources.title: Sakura Ishikari SOC report renewal notice
sources.summary: Operator refers to the Ishikari Data Center it operates and reports SOC2 Type2/SOC3 renewal.
sources.date_semantics: August 3 is notice publication; July 31 is report renewal. Audit coverage is June 1, 2025 through May 31, 2026. Neither report renewal nor publication is an opening date; this notice is corroboration and does not refresh the audit period.

sources.title: Ishikari city plan names Sakura Ishikari campus on detailed location map
sources.summary: Page 5 labels Sakura Internet Ishikari Data Center on a specific compound beside Minato-dori and Sun Village Ishikari; used with GSI tiles for an approximate campus point.
sources.date_semantics: Cover states submitted January 28, 2026; exact online publication day unknown. Location evidence only, not data-center permit or fresh status.

sources.title: GSI standard tile anchoring Sakura Ishikari campus marker
sources.summary: Selected native tile pixel 240,250 at z16/x58490/y24036 yields an interior campus marker after manual identity matching against the municipal map. Geometry facts list the full four-tile context mosaic.
sources.date_semantics: Retrieval date is neither map observation date nor data-center status date.

sources.title: GSI standard tile specification
sources.summary: Defines 256-pixel XYZ map tiles in Web Mercator; numeric tile addresses anchor the georeference to longitude and latitude.
sources.date_semantics: Undated technical reference, retrieved October 13. Geometry reference only.
sources.capture_reuse_note: Exact same URL and response hash already published. Preserve canonical original evidence metadata and raw capture; later identical response corroborates the same technical specification.

sources.title: Sakura official Ishikari campus profile
sources.summary: Operator campus profile identifies Ishikari and distinguishes its low-rise building groups; corroborates named-campus identity and operator role.
sources.date_semantics: Undated profile is identity context only and is not treated as an October 14 physical observation.

sources.title: Ishikari city directory separately lists Sakura and Renewable Energy DC No.1
sources.summary: Directory separately identifies Sakura Ishikari under Green Energy Data Center No.1 and the Tokyu, Flower Communications and Agility project under Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1.
sources.date_semantics: Directory retrieval is identity context only, not a new physical milestone.

sources.title: Ishikari city establishes regional data-center consortium
sources.summary: City describes a consortium joining locally situated data-center businesses and power and communications infrastructure businesses. This establishes regional collaboration, not common-property identity.
sources.date_semantics: July 28 page update supports consortium context only; no lease, tenancy or physical campus merger is inferred.
